task.title: Paste-to-attach: attach an image from the clipboard
task.description: The obvious sibling of drag+drop attach (PR #109, WB-01M05GZJEFZNFC3B62MTDNCJBG), noticed there and deliberately not implemented. Cmd+V of an image (screenshot in the clipboard) while a task view or the create form has focus should stage/upload it through the same acceptFiles(files) seam, with the same ceilings and busy-freeze rules. Clipboard paste events carry files via event.clipboardData.files/items; the same types-discrimination and folder cautions apply. Consider a generated filename (pasted-<timestamp>.png) since clipboard images carry none.
